Class ScenarioSpatiotemporalSectionBuilder

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.ui.scenario.ScenarioSpatiotemporalSectionBuilder
public class ScenarioSpatiotemporalSectionBuilder extends Object
UI Section Builder for Epoch, Spatiotemporal resolution, and H3 hexagonal discretization.

Configures:

  • Chronological timeline boundaries: $t_0 \in [-100\,000, +2\,100]$ to $t_{\text{end}}$
  • H3 spatial resolution: $r \in [1, 8]$ ($41\,162$ to $2\,800\,000$ cells)
  • Temporal step: $\Delta t \in [1.0, 365.0]$ days
  • Agent cohort Dunbar grouping: $N_{\text{cohort}} \in [1, 50\,000]$ hab/cohort
Version:
1.0.0-beta.2
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot
